name: Voidtrain: Tour de Void
summary:
Set off on a tour with the Rofleemo! Take on their tasks, earn tickets, and spend them on new perks, skins, trophies, and lootboxes to enhance your journey through the Void.

Leaving some of your Rofleemo behind at the depot is always a little sad — their Engineer heads deeper into the Void, while they have to stay there simply because there’s no room for them on the crew. With the Tour de Void DLC this finally changes. The game introduces a new mechanic that allows pets to travel with you for a while as tourists, so they can reach the station they need and stay there safely.
